correctness.rationale: For Heawood Fano incidence p_i--l_j iff i-j in {0,1,3} mod7, independently reconstructed all 21 edges and 644 original disjoint-edge triples. The actual 1680-row integer cubical d3 has rank 643 mod3. A freshly solved null vector has exactly 196 entries +1, 196 entries -1, 252 zero; every integer boundary equation vanishes. All 644 cube triples satisfy support iff their extra induced edges form a nonempty matching: (0,false):84, (1,true):168, (2,true):168, (2,false):168, (3,true):56. Independently regenerated all 336 Fano incidence automorphisms including 168 dualities, verified signed coefficient invariance and orbit counts active 168,168,56 and inactive 168,56,28. Bisected edge complex has 35 vertices, 42 edges, 9072 top cubes and 24654 nonempty d3 rows; the explicit 8-fold oriented subdivision gives 3136 unit entries, each full integral row sums to zero. Fresh sparse mod3 elimination yields rank 9071. A nonzero integral chain and mod3 rank bound force rational kernel dimension one; integer kernel is saturated, a unit entry ensures primitive generator, and there is no C4 for three particles. Distinct essential vertices have subdivided distance >=2, and cycles >=12 edges, meeting published n=3 Abrams conditions; the cubical model is a deformation retract of UConf3. Thus H3=Z, the canonical fixed cellular norm is exactly 3136, and all 336 actions are +1. The original D0 is only an auxiliary complex, not asserted equivalent to the continuous space.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge qualified: the exact earlier published Heawood result already establishes integral H3=Z using an 881-term reduced-Swiatkowski generator; that known rank is explicitly not original. The present claim is the specified one-bisection Abrams cubical primitive chain with 3136 unit cells, the auxiliary 392-cell matching support test, six orbits and the complete 336-automorphism trivial integral character. These are not logically implied by the prior rank or a noncanonical chain in another model. Direct primary source comparison of other graph-particle examples found no covering result; unindexed or inaccessible equivalent constructions remain possible.
residual_risks: An–Drummond-Cole–Knudsen primary full technical text was not independently read in this review; its general methods and unpublished appendices remain possible overlap.
An unindexed publication or private calculation could contain the same 392/3136 cubical coefficient or full group-character result.
The exact norm 3136 has meaning only for the one-bisection edge cellulation; it is not a subdivision-invariant systole.
The same-object earlier H3=Z and existence of a primitive generator are established prior results, not new claims.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is a natural highly symmetric 14-vertex cubic incidence graph; its unordered three-particle top homology has a known abstract integral rank but previously no located canonical combinatorial representative or equivariant classification. The 392-element induced-matching rule gives a structural description of exactly which of 644 natural edge triples carry the generator, and the corresponding 3136-cell primitive model is equivariant under all 336 symmetries, including dualities. The trivial character is meaningful because an integral rank-one module can admit a nontrivial sign character; the result identifies which occurs. This gives a concrete natural benchmark and reusable cycle data for graph braid homology. The number 3136 alone would be model-dependent and insufficient for value; the support criterion and full equivariant computation provide the substantive motivation. Known H3 rank and elementary nonproduct consequence are credited and not oversold.
residual_risks: No general graph-family theorem or universal minimal-cube norm is proved; contribution is natural exact structural and equivariant classification.

limitations: Published same-object H3=Z rank and the old reduced 881-term integral chain are prior, not novel.
One-bisection cellular norm is not intrinsic; raw 392-cube D0 is not a topological model for three-particle space.
Bona fide exact independent finite-matrix arithmetic, but no formal Lean or external expert certification.
